items.name: Belgorod Open 2017

venue.name: [Belgorod University of Cooperation, Economy and Law](http://www.bukep.ru)

items.information: All 18 events! Registration will be closed at midnight on October, 4 or when we reach 200 competitors. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * **FREE** for students of Belgorod University of Cooperation, Economy and Law; * **100 RUB**(~2 USD) for any one event (for ex. Rubik's Cube only); * **200 RUB** (~4 USD) for equal or less than 10 events; * **+10 RUB** for earch event more 10; (for ex. 280 RUB for 18 events); If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:ruslan.chaika@mail.ru,robota.av@gmail.com) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/belgorodopen2017) for more details.

items.name: Italian Open 2017
items.information: At a certain point we'll send an email to confirm your participation; competitors who don't confirm within the date specified in that email will be deleted. Remember to check your inbox 2-3 weeks before the competiton. [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Clicca qui per il sito web in italiano](https://cubingitaly.org/io-17)

items.name: Maryland 2017

venue.name: Adele H. Stamp Student Union
venue.address: 3100 Adele H. Stamp Student Union, College Park, MD 20742

items.information: Registration cost is $15 online. Registration at the door will not be allowed. Free for UMD students, faculty, staff, and alumni. There is a 300 person competitor limit. Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering.

items.name: Newport Fall 2017

venue.name: Harbor Day School
venue.details: The competition will take place in the Blass Gymnasium.

items.information: The competition will be held in the Blass Gymnasium. The cost of registration is a flat fee of $22.97. $1 of your registration fee will go to CubingUSA and $1 will go towards funding SoCal cubing expenses. We will **not be taking registration at the door.** See the tabs for more details.

items.name: NIT Trichy Open 2017

venue.name: [National Institute of Technology](http://www.nitt.edu/home/)
venue.address: Tanjore Main Road, National Highway 67,Tiruchirappalli - 620015, Tamil Nadu, India

items.information: Spot registrations will not be allowed. Make sure you register over here on or before the 4th of October. The registration fees will be an **INR 130 base fee** with which you can participate for a maximum of **4 events** plus **INR 30 for every additional event**. The registration fee will have to be paid at the venue. For first timers : Please refer to the WCA regulations before attending the competition. To register, create a WCA account by signing up, confirm your account and then come back to this page and register.

items.name: Utah Speedcube Speedoff 2017
items.information: Competitors must sign up and pay online to be considered fully registered. Cubes will be sold at the competition by [Oliver's Twisted Puzzles](http://www.oliverstwistedpuzzles.com/).

venue.name: [Westin Galleria Houston](https://www.starwoodhotels.com/westin/property/overview/index.html?propertyID=1053)
venue.details: The venue will be held in the Woodway III room on the Fourth Level.

items.information: This competition will have a 150 person competitor limit. Registration opens September 7th, 7pm CST. Competitors must register online by October 1st and pay online in order to reserve their spot in the competition.
